pages.title: Andalusian
pages.text: An agile, strong Iberian breed with a thick mane, common across open meadows.

pages.title: Warhorse Courage
pages.text:
An Andalusian **never rears when it is hit**, so the rider keeps their aim through a fight.

Taking damage also steadies the pair rather than panicking them: **Resistance I for 3 seconds**, on the horse and on whoever is in the saddle.

It still rears when it jumps, and standing idle. Only the flinch is gone.

pages.title: Where They Live
pages.text:
Open meadows and light woodland:

- Meadow
- Cherry Grove
- Flower Forest
- Plains
